courses.title: Financial Accounting & Analysis
courses.description: Master the language of business. Understand financial statements, accounting principles, and how to read a company's financial health.

Understand GAAP principles and double-entry accounting
Analyze financial ratios and business performance

Week 5: Financial Ratios — Liquidity, Profitability, Leverage
Week 6: Working Capital Management
Week 7: Cost Accounting & Managerial Decisions

Week 10: Final Project — Full Financial Analysis of Okta's 10-K
assignments: Weekly problem sets (10 total)
Mid-course: Build a 3-statement model for a startup
Final: Comprehensive financial analysis of Okta's annual report

courses.title: Business Statistics & Data-Driven Decisions
